definitions.gloss: mosquito repelling; mosquito-repellent device or product
definitions.explanation: The act or means of repelling or killing mosquitoes. Used as a prefix in compound words for mosquito-repellent products, especially the iconic spiral incense coil.

examples.japanese: {蚊取|かと}り⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧。
⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{蚊取|かと}り⟦グッズ→グッズ：10800_guzzu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{売|う}れる→売れる：02012_ureru⟧。
examples.english: Mosquito-repellent products sell well when summer comes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{縁側|えんがわ}→縁側：04495_engawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{蚊取|かと}り⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}いて→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦{夕涼|ゆうすず}み→夕涼み：15371_yuusuzumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We placed mosquito coils on the veranda and enjoyed the cool evening.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{蚊|か}→蚊：04294_ka⟧ (mosquito) and ⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧ (catching, removing). Most commonly encountered in the compound {蚊取|かと}り⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧ (mosquito coil), a green spiral incense that is a quintessential symbol of Japanese summer. The coil is typically placed in a pig-shaped ceramic holder called a ⟦{蚊遣|かや}り{豚|ぶた}→蚊遣り豚：30353_kayaributa⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蚊取|かと}り⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧: mosquito coil (spiral incense)
- {蚊取|かと}り⟦マット→マット：21812_matto⟧: mosquito-repellent mat (heated electric type)
- {蚊取|かと}りリキッド: liquid mosquito repellent
- {蚊取|かと}り{器|き}: mosquito-repelling device

CULTURAL NOTE:
The {蚊取|かと}り⟦{線香|せんこう}→線香：09995_senkou⟧ is strongly associated with Japanese summer and traditional living. It appears frequently in literature, anime, and advertising as an evocative seasonal image alongside ⟦{風鈴|ふうりん}→風鈴：09929_fuurin⟧ (wind chimes) and {西瓜|すいか} (watermelon).
